returns.text: Customers may return items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Items must be unused and in their original packaging. Proof of purchase is required.

refunds.text: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5-7 business days after the returned item has been received and inspected.

shipping.text: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days and is free for orders over 50 EUR. Express shipping (1-2 business days) costs 9.99 EUR.

warranty.text: All electronics carry a 12-month manufacturer warranty covering defects. Accidental damage is not covered by the warranty.

order_tracking.text: Customers can track their orders on the 'My Orders' page using the order number from the confirmation email.

contact.text: Human support is available Monday to Friday, 09:00-17:00 CET, via support@shopco.example or +385 1 234 5678.
